inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: This looks like a power grab being pushed through constitutional procedure. Sikhala is warning people that the proposed amendments are reportedly designed to extend Mnangagwa’s term to 2030, with those in power using legal language to make it seem legitimate. The missing details aren’t reassuring; they look like part of keeping the public from seeing what’s being arranged until it’s too late. The bill should be rejected before it’s presented as a fait accompli.
